title: Unified chat and Cowork for Claude Enterprise
summary: The unified chat and Cowork experience is now generally available for Enterprise on web, desktop, and mobile, with no mode selection required. Simple questions get quick answers, while code and file tasks run in a managed cloud environment that keeps going after the laptop is closed, and existing chats, projects, connectors, skills, and plugins carry over. Security features include an isolated VM per session, network off by default, SSO, Compliance API, and role-based access, and cost controls include usage-based pricing, a new Efficient mode (Sonnet and Haiku only), per-role models, spend limits, and pooled budgets.

title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
summary: Claude Duet is a research-preview agent that uses a cloud computer to handle tasks like inbox management, drafts, bookings, and routines while the user is away. It adds approval controls that show the action, destination, and content before sensitive sends, payments, or deletions, always blocks some actions such as trading or moving money, and an outgoing-message classifier keeps credentials, card and bank numbers, and government IDs from being shared. Anthropic notes that safeguards will sometimes miss things and that approval frequency and sign-in methods are still being refined.

title: Claude for Financial Advisors
summary: Claude for Financial Advisors is a Cowork plugin of connectors and workflow skills that link to custodians such as Schwab and Addepar as well as portfolio, CRM, and planning tools. Its skills cover meeting prep, follow-up, rebalance review, estate and tax briefs, and compliance checks such as SEC Marketing Rule flags, and advisors must review and approve drafts and CRM updates. The goal is to free up advisor time, since advisors spend only about a sixth of their time in client meetings, and Enterprise plans are recommended for audit logs.

title: IDC brings Quanta into Claude and adopts Claude across the company
summary: IDC Research integrated its IDC Quanta platform into Claude through an MCP connector, so customers can query forecasts, market data, and research and get answers that cite IDC sources. IDC also rolled Claude out company-wide, starting with engineering, where internal results show the data repository rebuilt in 3 weeks instead of about 3 months and code review cut from 5 days to about 30 minutes. The company says market research that once took days can now be done in minutes inside the tools customers already use.

title: Make long-running agents faster with message threads
summary: Message threads are now in public beta in the Claude Platform Messages API. Clients add a thread parameter so later requests send only new messages plus the previous response ID, and median time to first token in Claude Code fell about 35% on 500k-1M token requests with token usage unchanged. Threads are held encrypted in memory and expire 5 minutes after the last request, which suits long-running coding agents, computer use agents, and document- or image-heavy workflows.

title: Introducing artifacts for legal work
summary: Anthropic introduced ready-to-use interactive legal artifacts, such as trackers and dashboards, as part of Claude for Legal, including a legal gallery for cite checking, matter boards, playbook deviation, and tabular contract review. Teams start from prebuilt tools, outputs link to sources, and contributions from Goodwin, Harvey, Foley & Lardner, and PwC are included alongside nine access-to-justice artifacts and 60+ legal connectors. Lawyers still review all output, and sharing is governed by privacy and ethical-wall controls.
